layouts.name: Goodwood Festival of Speed
layouts.description: The open hillclimb follows the paved Western first corner past Goodwood House, the Northeast straight, Molecomb left turn and Northern wooded return. The operator course plan identifies this sequence; unrelated Eastern estate roads and grass paths are excluded. Centerline vertices are independently inspected on 2014 Environment Agency georeferenced imagery; the wooded Northern section is corroborated by pinned public road mapping. Tree cover, historic timing extent and fine corner alignment remain draft. The timing catalogue scalar is 2806 m while the operator describes a 1.16-mile hillclimb; the independent timed route is not scaled to either figure. Identification plan: https://www.goodwood.com/globalassets/pdfs/motorsport/fos/fos-3dmap-nocf-2025.pdf . The independent gate-to-gate route measures 1679.8 m, 1126.2 m shorter than the catalogue scalar and approximately 187 m shorter than the operator description. This unresolved historical timing-extent discrepancy is retained with an explicit 1150 m allowance, rather than adding unrelated roads or extending the route beyond its timing endpoints. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1679.8 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
